timeline_convention: Controls are sanitized and accepted only when a persistent 16-frame source quantum begins. Phase offsets the existing Q32 lane phase, Shape forms the accepted continuous Motion value, and Rotate enters only the modulo-16 Euclidean predicate. Per-lane normalized energy accumulates for every rendered post-level pre-cohesion sample and is copied through the accepted Snapshot. Activity reduction differences consecutive accepted counters on the UI side. Clear applies at one accepted quantum. Host intervals are half-open and outer partitioning never changes Core/event/telemetry bytes.

tolerances.activity_display_bounds: every reduced lane/body level is finite in [0,1], silence is exact zero, and reset emits one zero rebase sample
tolerances.clear: pre-Clear silent-input tail peak is at least 5e-4 normalized; next effect-only quantum is exact zero; one generation/count/event changes; musical/scheduler/source state remains exact
tolerances.controller_partition_artifacts: byte exact within one frozen build for 1, 16, 64, 128, 257, and 512 frame hosts
tolerances.global_parameter_response: each one-at-a-time active Drive, Root, Spread, Tail, Damping, Width, and Duck comparison has normalized stereo RMS difference at least 5e-4 or a stronger parameter-specific invariant
tolerances.lane_energy: finite nonnegative cumulative values, monotone while the transport is continuous, zero for silent/unstarted lanes, reset to zero, and exact across partitions
tolerances.phase: Phase 0 and 64 produce different eligible trigger frames while rate and frozen hit count remain equal
tolerances.rotate: Rotate 0 and 3 produce different eligible trigger positions with equal 5-of-16 cardinality
tolerances.shape: trigger-only event timing is exact across shapes; nonzero Pitch Motion produces different finite modulation trajectories and representative PCM
